executive_summary.text: Cost year 2025: direct care cost was $195.78 per resident day (45.0% of expenses); Connecticut median $174.45.
Cost year 2025: nursing home operating margin was 12.2% (Connecticut median 2.5%).
Cost year 2025: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $644,543, 7.2% of the $8,988,459 direct care cost.

Cost year 2025: dietary cost $1,601,350, $34.88 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.51). Wages $836,976 (52.3%), allocated fringe $171,618 (10.7%), non-wage costs $592,756 (37.0%). Raw food was $571,452 ($12.45 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.61) and purchased dietary services $762.
Cost year 2025: housekeeping cost $550,012, $11.98 per resident day (Connecticut median $12.32). Wages $0 (0.0%), allocated fringe $0 (0.0%), non-wage costs $550,012 (100.0%).
Cost year 2025: laundry cost $429,554, $9.36 per resident day (Connecticut median $5.66). Wages $136,664 (31.8%), allocated fringe $28,022 (6.5%), non-wage costs $264,868 (61.7%).
Missing data: cost years 2015, 2016 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; nursing hours per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total; balance sheet does not add up). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

Cost year 2016 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
